Smilearc Engineering Limited is a professional engineering and construction company committed to delivering quality, innovative and sustainable building solutions.

We specialise in building construction, civil engineering, architectural services, project management and general contracting. Our approach combines technical expertise, creativity and attention to detail to deliver projects that meet our clients’ expectations, industry standards and safety requirements.

We believe every project deserves excellence, integrity and professionalism. We build lasting relationships through reliability, transparency, timely delivery and exceptional workmanship.

Our goal is to become a trusted name in the industry by transforming ideas into reality and creating structures that stand the test of time.

Health, Safety & Environment

Protecting our people, our clients and the environment is part of how we plan and carry out every project.

Our HSE commitment

At Smilearc Engineering Limited, we believe good engineering and responsible working go together. We are committed to planning and carrying out our projects in a way that protects the health and safety of our team, our clients, visitors and the communities around our sites, and that limits our impact on the environment. Everyone on a project, from management to site crews, shares responsibility for working safely and for speaking up when something is not right.

People come firstNobody should be harmed by the work we do.
Prevent before we buildThink ahead, assess risks and plan precautions.
Respect the environmentWork responsibly with our surroundings and resources.

Our HSE focus areas

The principles that guide how we work, from the first plan to the final handover.

Health and Safety Commitment

We treat the health and safety of everyone involved in a project as a core requirement, not an afterthought. Safety is considered from the first planning discussion through to handover.

Workplace Safety Standards

We expect safe working practices on every site, including suitable protective equipment, tidy and well-maintained work areas, and the safe handling of tools, materials and equipment.

Environmental Responsibility

We aim to carry out our work with respect for the environment and for neighbouring communities, managing waste, materials and site activity responsibly.

Risk Prevention and Management

We aim to identify hazards before work begins, assess the risks, put sensible controls in place, and review them as site conditions change.

Employee Health and Welfare

The wellbeing of our team matters. We aim to provide a respectful working environment and to look after the health and welfare of our employees and site crews.

Safety Training and Awareness

We support safety awareness through clear guidance and communication, so that people understand the risks of their work and how to manage them.

Accident Prevention and Emergency Preparedness

We work to prevent accidents before they happen, and we aim to make sure site teams know what to do in an emergency, including how to raise the alarm and get help quickly.

Environmental Sustainability

We look for practical ways to reduce waste, use resources efficiently and build durable structures that serve our clients for many years.

How we approach every project

A simple cycle we aim to follow on each job. Detailed procedures are set out in the company HSE policy.

  1. Plan

    We consider safety and environmental impact during planning and design.

  2. Assess

    We identify hazards and assess the risks before work starts.

  3. Control

    We put sensible precautions in place and brief the people involved.

  4. Work

    We carry out work with suitable equipment and supervision.

  5. Review

    We check, learn and improve as the project progresses.
